response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with a long track record across web, mobile, and embedded platforms, but he falls well short of this Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. His experience totals roughly 14 years but is overwhelmingly general software engineering (web, GIS, embedded, media apps) rather than deep cloud/AI expertise or strategic technical leadership. Aside from recent, brief mention of MCP and agentic workflow tooling, there is no evidence of building AI products/platforms, advising strategic customers, or driving cloud/AI strategy at a director level.
strengths: Broad full-stack and cross-platform engineering experience (web, mobile, embedded, DevOps)
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive via founding and maintaining GISCollective long-term
Strong community engagement: talks, workshops, open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal, very recent and shallow AI/ML experience (only brief MCP/agentic tooling mention)
No evidence of cloud strategy, platform-level architecture, or advising strategic enterprise customers
Career trajectory is senior IC/staff level, not demonstrating director-level strategic influence or scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/ML depth and product experience
No cloud strategy or enterprise advisory experience
